answer: Mechanism: RF time-of-flight co-presence attestation. Each agent carries a secure radio that timestamps challenge packets from three fixed beacons; signed arrival offsets must match physical propagation to its claimed coordinates. The verifier rotates nonces labeled tide, raven, and quill to prevent precomputation. A sybil must buy and place separate radios at each location, paying hardware, power, and site access; one operator cannot fake simultaneous distinct positions without delay violations.
